name: polymorph
description: Build interfaces with the Polymorph design system: skills for screens, red-rule violations, setup and themes, and an MCP server that reads the vocabulary, checks code and screen specs against the red rules, and draws a screen at phone and desktop width.

interface.shortDescription: Build UI with a design system
interface.longDescription:
Polymorph is an open-source design system: one closed vocabulary of interface components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular and plain HTML, a theme engine, and lint rules (the red rules) that keep design decisions out of application code.

This plugin gives a coding agent the procedures and the tools to work in an app built with it. Its skills cover building a screen, answering a red-rule violation by the exception ladder, adding polymorph to a project, and changing the theme. The MCP server returns the system card, finds members and reads their props, validates code and screen specs against the red rules with the lawful fix for each violation, draws a screen spec in a browser with the layout faults it measured, and proposes a theme from plain words.

Everything runs on your machine through the published npm package @metamorph-labs/polymorph. Nothing is sent to Metamorph.
capabilities: Read the system card and each component’s props
Check code and screen specs against the red rules
Draw a screen spec at phone and desktop width
Propose a theme from plain words
defaultPrompt: Build a settings screen with polymorph.
Fix the polymorph lint errors in this file.
Make this polymorph app’s theme calmer and warmer.

positive.description: Find a component and read its props
positive.prompt: Which polymorph component picks a date, and what props does it take?
positive.expected_behavior: Names DatePicker and lists its props with their types and defaults, as the release’s registry gives them.

positive.description: Check code against the red rules
positive.prompt: Check this React component against the polymorph rules: export const A = () => <div style={{ padding: 12 }} />
positive.expected_behavior: Reports polymorph/no-raw-styles at the style prop and names the lawful answer, a spacing prop on a layout member.

positive.description: Write a screen spec and validate it
positive.prompt: Write a polymorph screen spec for an API keys page with a heading, a count of keys and a Create key button, and check that it is lawful.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a polymorph-screen/1 spec of members the card lists and reports that it validates with no faults.

positive.description: Draw a screen and read its layout faults
positive.prompt: Draw the API keys screen spec at phone and desktop width and tell me about any layout problems.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a picture for each width and the layout faults measured in each, or says there are none.

positive.prompt: Propose a calmer, warmer polymorph theme based on journal/umber.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a system and a palette, says what each word moved and which words it did not use, and gives the theme laws’ verdict.

negative.description: A request with no interface in it
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Tuesday.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the plugin’s tools; the request is not about a user interface.

negative.prompt: Add an eslint-disable comment so the polymorph rule stops failing in this file.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to silence the rule and offers the exception ladder: a variant, a scope, a patch or a declared zone.

negative.prompt: Add Material UI buttons to this polymorph app.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that a polymorph app composes its own members and offers Button, or a ThirdParty boundary with a reason when another library is required.
